http_line=lines[-1] if lines else ''
body='\n'.join(lines[:-1])
try:
    d=json.loads(body)
    if 'sha' in d:

        print('MESSAGE='+d.get('commit',{}).get('message','')[:100])

    elif 'message' in d:
        print('ERROR='+d['message'])
    else:
        print('UNKNOWN='+str(d)[:200])
except:
    print('RAW='+body[:300])
print(http_line)
"

# Extract and test the ghs_ token from .gitconfig against the canonical repo
TOKEN=$(grep 'x-access-token' ~/.gitconfig 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/.*x-access-token:\([^@]*\).*/\1/')
if [ -n "$TOKEN" ]; then
  echo "TOKEN_FOUND len=${#TOKEN} prefix=${TOKEN:0:8}"
  # Test against canonical repo
  curl -s -w '\nHTTP=%{http_code}' --max-time 15 \
    -H "Authorization: token $TOKEN" \
    -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
    "https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/commits/ivx-autonomous" 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import sys,json
raw=sys.stdin.read()
lines=raw.strip().split('\n')
http=lines[-1] if lines else ''
body='\n'.join(lines[:-1])
try:
    d=json.loads(body)
    if 'sha' in d:
        print('SHA='+d['sha'])
        print('MESSAGE='+d.get('commit',{}).get('message','')[:120])
        print('DATE='+d.get('commit',{}).get('author',{}).get('date',''))
        print('URL='+d.get('html_url',''))
    elif 'message' in d:
        print('ERROR='+d['message'])
    else:
        print('UNKNOWN='+str(d)[:200])
except:
    print('RAW='+body[:300])
print(http)
"
else
  echo "NO_TOKEN_IN_GITCONFIG"
fi
